resources.string: Scan every channel and hide the ones that keep failing

A scan tries every live channel, one at a time, the way an old TV scanned for stations. If the internet drops or the server stops answering, the scan waits or stops instead of blaming channels. A channel is hidden only after failing in two scans at least six hours apart, and comes back as soon as a scan finds it working.
The scan pauses while you watch something, so only one stream is ever open.
The scan stopped because the internet was down. No channels were blamed for it.
The scan stopped because the server wasn\'t sending any streams. No channels were blamed for it.
The scan stopped because your account was using all its connections, probably on another device. Try again later.
Leaves out slots named like “No event streaming” until the provider names a real event
Turn off to show every channel, including the ones scans hid
